patch_resolves_note: The staged fix deletes the heap-backed `malloc(size)` / `FUZZ_dataProducer_create(uncompressedData, size)` path, derives `uncompressedData` from the original fuzz input with fuzz-chosen offsets, and on the exact witness reaches the same `LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate()` call with `uncompressedSize = 0`, so the call no longer admits uninitialized heap bytes into the library.
verification_limitations: On the exact fixed witness, the patched fuzzer chooses a zero-length uncompressed slice (`uncompressedSize = 0`), so the downstream `auto_flush_dispatch` and `hash_position_sink` events are not exercised on the fixed side; only the root call-site obligation is witnessed differentially.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-side consumption of the attacker-controlled witness into vulnerability-relevant local state. This call parses preference bytes from the fuzz buffer and mutates `producer->size`, the state later reused as the vulnerable `size`.

Root cause. `compress_round_trip()` passes the heap buffer allocated at line 47 to `LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate()` as if it already contained initialized uncompressed payload bytes. Nothing writes to that buffer first, so the library receives raw heap data as input.

Repo-source sink for the saved MSan crash. On the witnessed `byU16` path selected for the 18-byte block in `LZ4_compress_fast_extState_fastReset()`, this helper reads the first 4 bytes of `p` from the uninitialized `uncompressedData` block to compute the hash.

Inside the `if ((cctxPtr->prefs.autoFlush) && (srcPtr < srcEnd))` branch, `LZ4F_compressUpdateImpl()` dispatches the remaining short uncompressed input directly to `LZ4F_makeBlock()` instead of buffering it.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `auto_flush_dispatch.src_remaining=18` and `auto_flush_dispatch.block_size=65536` at the branch-local event, so the remaining input is a short block that the autoFlush path forwards immediately.

edges.description: The same `uncompressedData` pointer admitted by `LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate()` becomes the `srcPtr` value dispatched by the later autoFlush short-block branch.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `uncompressed_update_root.uncompressed_data_ptr == auto_flush_dispatch.src_buffer_ptr`.

edges.description: The short uncompressed source pointer dispatched by `LZ4F_compressUpdateImpl()` reaches `LZ4_hashPosition()` unchanged as the `p` pointer whose first bytes are hashed.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `auto_flush_dispatch.src_buffer_ptr == hash_position_sink.hash_input_ptr`.
